intent: Add five bilingual public-media case studies using only existing Instagram and YouTube evidence, while preserving Esteban Moreno Media's existing case-study experience.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The work extends an already approved case-study template with existing project media rather than introducing a new visual direction.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: Motion never gates the words; real project media is proof, not decoration.
visual_evidence.comparison: Existing Esteban case-study template and public portfolio watch pages.

brief.visitor: A phone-first prospective restaurant, creator, fitness, or documentary client comparing real examples before contacting Esteban.
brief.promise: See the published work, understand the narrow confirmed role, and reach the matching existing service without reading unsupported results.
brief.primary_action: Open the existing matching service or contact Esteban for a scoped project.
brief.friction: The new portfolio pages prove finished work but do not yet give visitors a concise, structured case-study explanation.

kpi.event: service or contact action from a case study
kpi.baseline: UNKNOWN: no comparable case-study attribution read this session
kpi.evidence: Five source-backed public portfolio routes are live.
kpi.decision_rule: retain only if later attributable inquiry data is measurable without a quality regression.

concept.idea: Use the existing case-study page as a calm reading layer above each public portfolio item.
concept.brand_reason: The completed media, not a new visual treatment, carries the proof.
concept.interaction: Existing video facade and source links remain optional; text and next steps are served immediately.
concept.visible_response: The visitor can verify a source or continue to the relevant service without a social embed or hidden content.
concept.alternatives: No Instagram embed, autoplay, invented scope, new generic service page, or outcome claim.

story.opening: The first screen names the project and the limited confirmed role.
story.action: The visitor watches or opens the source, then chooses the matching existing service.
story.consequence: A specific type of work becomes easier to evaluate without expanding claims.

content.visible: Title, source-backed summary, produced role, deliverable as published video, source link, relevant service, contact.
content.optional_html: No additional optional content beyond existing template behavior.
content.linked_depth: Existing portfolio, matching service, and contact pages.

references.borrow: Existing Esteban case-study component, YouTube facade, portfolio watch pages, and bilingual routing.
references.avoid: Social-platform chrome, duplicate generic SEO pages, and unverified business outcomes.

components.reuse: case-studies data model, CaseStudyPage, portfolio data, sitemap and language alternates.
components.local_reason: This is data/content expansion within an established brand-specific case-study surface.

verification.rendered_states: 375x667, 390x844 and desktop for a YouTube case and an Instagram-source case; keyboard source/service links.
verification.motion: Existing YouTube facade only; reduced-motion preserves the poster and served text.
verification.accessibility_performance: Existing labelled links and poster-first behavior; no social script dependency.
verification.raw_html: Every EN/ES route exposes title, produced role, source and service link in initial HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Existing contact route remains available; no message is sent.

learning.baseline_source: UNKNOWN: no dated, case-study-specific inquiry export is available
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no dated, case-study-specific inquiry export is available
learning.target: case-study service or contact action to qualified inquiry
learning.hypothesis: Clear, source-bounded examples help visitors decide whether their project resembles proven work.
learning.decision_rule: retain pages if production behavior passes and attributable inquiry data becomes available; otherwise keep factual proof but do not assert outcome.
learning.registration_condition: record comparable production event availability before outcome grading
